record.original_question: A square-free monomial ideal I ⊆ S = K[x0, ..., xn] is called a square-free Gotzmann ideal when it can be written as m1(x_i : i in J1) + m1m2(x_i : i in J2) + ... + m1...ms(x_i : i in Js) for square-free monomials m1, ..., ms and pairwise disjoint subsets J1, ..., Js of {0, 1, ..., n}. Which square-free Gotzmann ideals satisfy the weak Lefschetz property, and do any Artinian reductions of Stanley-Reisner ideals of chordal complexes satisfy the weak Lefschetz property?

evidence.quote: Question 2.13. Which square free Gotzmann ideals satisfy the WLP? Do (some) Artinian reductions of Stanley-Reisner ideals of chordal complexes satisfy the WLP?

A square-free monomial ideal I ⊆ S = K[x0, · · · xn] is called Gotzmann ideal if and only if I = m1(xi : i ∈ J1) + m1m2(xi : i ∈ J2) + · · · + m1m2 · · · ms(xi : i ∈ Js) for some square-free monomials m1, . . . , ms and pairwise disjoint subsets J1, . . . , Js of {0, 1, . . . , n}.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $K$ be a field and $S = K[x_0, x_1, \dots, x_n]$ the standard graded polynomial ring. A square-free monomial ideal $I \subseteq S$ is called a square-free Gotzmann ideal if it admits a decomposition
$$I = m_1\,(x_i : i \in J_1) + m_1 m_2\,(x_i : i \in J_2) + \cdots + m_1 m_2 \cdots m_s\,(x_i : i \in J_s),$$
where $m_1, \dots, m_s$ are square-free monomials in $S$ and $J_1, \dots, J_s$ are pairwise disjoint subsets of $\{0, 1, \dots, n\}$.

An Artinian standard graded $K$-algebra $A = \bigoplus_{i \ge 0} A_i$ is said to have the weak Lefschetz property (WLP) if there exists a linear form $\ell \in A_1$ such that, for every $i \ge 0$, the multiplication map $\times \ell : A_i \to A_{i+1}$ has maximal rank.

A simplicial complex $\Delta$ on vertex set $\{0,1,\dots,n\}$ is called chordal (in the sense relevant here) if it can be obtained from a simplex by recursively removing facets that intersect the rest of the complex in a simplex; equivalently, $\Delta$ admits a simplicial-tree structure on its facets. Its Stanley–Reisner ideal $I_\Delta \subset S$ is generated by the square-free monomials corresponding to non-faces of $\Delta$. An Artinian reduction of $S/I_\Delta$ is the quotient $S/(I_\Delta + (\theta_1, \dots, \theta_d))$ where $\theta_1, \dots, \theta_d$ is a linear system of parameters for $S/I_\Delta$.

Solve the following:

(a) Characterize the square-free Gotzmann ideals $I \subseteq S$ such that $S/I$ (or its Artinian reduction, when not Artinian) has the weak Lefschetz property.

(b) Determine whether some (or all) Artinian reductions of the Stanley–Reisner ring of every chordal simplicial complex satisfy the weak Lefschetz property.
artifact.category_tag: Weak Lefschetz property of monomial ideals
artifact.status_search_result: Recent literature (2024–2025) on Lefschetz properties of squarefree monomial ideals, including work on Rees algebras and on mixed multiplicities, continues to investigate the WLP for classes that include squarefree Gotzmann and Stanley–Reisner ideals, but no general characterization for squarefree Gotzmann ideals nor a general WLP result for Artinian reductions of Stanley–Reisner rings of chordal complexes appears in the located sources. The questions therefore appear to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Lefschetz properties of squarefree monomial ideals via Rees algebras
status_evidence.snippet: The theory of Rees algebras of squarefree monomial ideals manifests itself in the theory of Lefschetz properties.
status_evidence.claim: Active recent investigations into WLP for squarefree monomial ideals, without resolving the general Gotzmann/chordal case.

status_evidence.title: The weak Lefschetz property and mixed multiplicities of monomial ideals
status_evidence.snippet: Explores WLP via analytic spread of equigenerated monomial ideals and mixed multiplicities.
status_evidence.claim: Recent partial approaches to WLP for monomial ideals; no full answer for squarefree Gotzmann ideals.

status_evidence.title: Gotzmann squarefree ideals
status_evidence.snippet: A squarefree ideal is Gotzmann if and only if it is the edge ideal of a supernova.
status_evidence.claim: Characterization of Gotzmann squarefree ideals is known, but their WLP behaviour is not addressed there.
